description: This is a C++ source file for the main entry point of a component in the Android Open Source Project, specifically for starting and managing Android virtual devices (AVDs) within the Cuttlefish project. It handles command-line argument parsing, configuration setup, and launching of subprocesses related to the virtual device environment.

methods.name: SubtoolPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a subtool executable based on the current executable directory.

methods.name: AssemblerPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the assemble_cvd tool.

methods.name: RunnerPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the run_cvd tool.

methods.name: InvokeAssembler
methods.description: Runs the assembler subprocess with specified input and captures its output.

methods.name: StartRunner
methods.description: Starts a runner subprocess for a given instance with specified arguments.

methods.name: WriteFiles
methods.description: Generates a string listing files from the fetcher configuration.

methods.name: HostToolsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if host tools have been updated by comparing CRCs.

methods.name: CvdInternalStartMain
methods.description: Main function that initializes logging, parses arguments, sets up configuration, and launches the virtual device environment.
